idea-plugin.name: Simple Rainbow Delimiters
idea-plugin.description:
Simple, free and open-source rainbow delimiter highlighting.

Rainbow coloring for (), [], {} based on nesting level.
Available for JetBrains IDEs, including IntelliJ IDEA, RustRover, Rider and CLion.

Features
  • Rainbow colors for (), [] and {} by nesting level
  • Support for Rust, C#, Java, Kotlin, C/C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, GLSL and more, including C++ module extensions
  • Skips strings and comments using the IDE's language lexer when available, with a fallback scanner
  • Four built-in palettes, editable colors, custom palette copies and a configurable number of colors
  • JSON palette import/export with light and dark theme variants
  • Saturation and brightness controls with live previews directly in every palette's color swatches, using the current IDE theme
  • Optional matching-pair underlines that keep the caret visible between adjacent brackets
  • Optional colored indent guides for multiline bracket pairs, parameter lists and arrays; enabled by default
  • Separate active and inactive guide transparency controls: 0% active and 75% inactive by default. Select a bracket or place a caret next to it to activate its guide
  • Theme-gray guides for unbraced case/default sections in C#, C and C++
  • Guides account for tabs, folding, soft wraps and Code Vision hints, and replace corresponding native guides to avoid duplicates
  • Enable/disable toggle, editable file extensions and settings saved across IDE restarts. Updates preserve your saved extension selection; use Defaults to load the latest list
  • Viewport-limited highlighting with cached delimiter scans
Open Source Source code on GitHub
